skills.label: Basic Attack: Crushing Strike
skills.gameText:

skills.label: Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace
skills.gameText:
Hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Yidhari begins charging, continuously consuming HP to reach up to three levels of charge. When [Basic Attack button] is released, Yidhari unleashes a powerful charged hammer attack in front based on the current charge level, dealing massive Ice DMG.
The higher Yidhari's HP, the faster charging consumes it. HP consumption will at most reduce Yidhari's HP to 25% of Max HP.
At 2 charge levels, after using the skill, press [Basic Attack button] to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Crushing Strike. The DMG of a Basic Attack: Crushing Strike triggered this way increases based on the current charge level, up to 30%.
At 3 charge levels, Yidhari gains increased Anti-Interrupt level during the charged skill. Press [Basic Attack button] to chain early into the finishing smash.

skills.label: Frost's Crushing Weight

While charging or spinning during Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace, if hit by an enemy, Yidhari can block with her tentacles, reducing the DMG taken by 25%.
If charging or not yet at full charge, Yidhari counterattacks with her tentacles, returning to the charging stance and instantly gaining 1 charge level, while also dealing Ice DMG to enemies ahead.
While Frost's Crushing Weight is active, pressing [Basic Attack button] makes Yidhari immediately unleash the finishing slam of Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace based on her current charge level.
While Frost's Crushing Weight is active, pressing [Special Attack button] or [EX Special Attack button] makes Yidhari unleash a Special Attack: Surging Cold, Crushing Pursuit that is guaranteed to trigger Surging Cold.

If the skill is used after Surging Cold, it grants an additional 15 Adrenaline. This effect can trigger once every 1s.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Dreamscape Collection (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:

Yidhari's skill DMG increases as her current HP percentage decreases.
When her HP falls below 50%, the buff reaches its maximum value, increasing her DMG by up to 100%. Once her HP is restored to 50%, the maximum bonus remains for 5s thereafter.
Yidhari gains fewer Decibels from landing skills. Instead, she gains Decibels as her HP decreases, with every 1% HP lost granting 10 Decibels.

After the level 3 charged attack of Yidhari's Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace or EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush, an icy tentacle is summoned to attack, dealing extra damage. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
The above skill is considered an EX Special Attack, the DMG multiplier increases based on the EX Special Attack's level.

skills.gameText: The Adrenaline cost to activate Yidhari's EX Special Attack is reduced by 10. After using EX Special Attack: Frost Coil or EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush, keeping hold of the Basic Attack or Special Attack button consumes 35 Adrenaline to forgo healing and immediately chain into another EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush. The HP restored by this EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush is increased by 100% of the original value. Yidhari's Basic Attacks and EX Special Attacks ignore 20% of targets' Ice RES.

skills.label: Core Passive: Searing Cold (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
When Hoshimi Miyabi deals Frost DMG, she applies Icefire to the target, lasting 30s. All units accumulate 20% more Anomaly Buildup against enemies under the Frostburn state, but Hoshimi Miyabi cannot reapply Icefire to these enemies. The Frostburn state ends when Frostbite expires. While this state remains active, triggering another Attribute Anomaly will overwrite Frostbite and remove Frostburn.

skills.label: Core Passive: Metallic Paws (Core Skill level 7) (Agent Potential 1+)
skills.gameText:
When Lycaon completes charging during a Basic Attack, or activates a Dodge Counter or Dash Attack, the Daze inflicted by the skill increases by 80%.
When EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt, Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack, or Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz hits an enemy, the target's Ice RES is reduced by 25%, and it increases the DMG to the target from other attributes by 30% for 30s.
Upon entering the battlefield, Lycaon gains one Encircle Prey activation chance.
When Encircle Prey has available activations, hitting an enemy with Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad. During this skill, when other squad members enter via Quick Assist, Lycaon enters the Encircle Prey state for 8s.
When an elite or boss enemy becomes Stunned, 1 Encircle Prey activation chance is gained. Up to 1 Encircle Prey activation can be stored.
When the Encircle Prey state ends, Lycaon automatically activates Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz. If the Encircle Prey state ends early, for every 1s of remaining duration, the Daze dealt by the next Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz increases by 6%.
When the currently active character stops attacking or uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Lycaon will end the Encircle Prey state early.
When Lycaon manually uses Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz, the Encircle Prey state also ends early, but Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz will not be automatically triggered.
While the Encircle Prey state is active, Lycaon will activate Basic Attack, Dodge, Dash Attack, and Dodge Counter based on the skills used by the currently active character.

skills.label: Core Passive: Terminating Verdict (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:

When there are 1/2 Stun characters in your squad, Hugo's ATK increases by 300/900.
When the Finishing Move of EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment or Ultimate: Blaspheme hits an enemy while they are Stunned, it triggers the Totalize effect, increasing the DMG Multiplier of the skill's Finishing Move by 1,000%. Additionally, the Totalize effect further increases the skill's DMG multiplier based on the remaining Stun time of the enemy when triggered: for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion that is less than or equal to 5s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by 280%; for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion between 5 and 15s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by 100%. The total increase can raise the skill's DMG multiplier by a maximum of 3,400%.
After Hugo triggers the Totalize effect, the enemy's Stunned state will immediately end. Based on the remaining Stun time at the moment Totalize is triggered, a certain amount of Daze will be accumulated. For every second of Stun time remaining, 5% Daze is accumulated, up to a maximum Daze equivalent to 25% of the enemy's maximum Daze.
When EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment hits an enemy, if the enemy is not Stunned, the Daze accumulated by the skill increases by 20%.

EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment generates an additional 20 Energy when triggering Totalize on normal enemies. The Energy generation effect can trigger once every 30s.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Feathered Strike
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
After triggering the fourth attack, enter the Noblewoman state.
With Flight Feathers available, holding [Basic Attack button] during the fourth attack will activate the Fluttering Frock state.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Noblewoman - Waltz
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] while in the Noblewoman state to activate:
Dash forward with an attack that deals Ether DMG and restores 1 Flight Feather upon hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered during the dash, gain 1 additional Flight Feather.
If Flight Feathers are available after the skill, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge button] when the skill is used.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] while in the Fluttering Frock state to activate:
Attack an area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
After activation, this skill consumes all Flight Feathers, and each one consumed grants 1 Guard Feather.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When switching characters during the Fluttering Frock state, Vivian will automatically perform Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension.
While in the Fluttering Frock state, press [Dodge button] to exit the state.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Featherbloom
skills.gameText:
After any squad member hits a target with an EX Special Attack, Vivian will consume 1 Guard Feather to launch Basic Attack: Featherbloom against the target, dealing Ether DMG, triggering at most once per use of a skill. This effect can trigger even while Vivian is off-field.
A maximum of 5 Guard Feathers can be stored.

skills.label: Dodge: Lightstream
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Silver Thorned Melody
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Launches a forward thrust at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Wingblade Reverb
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launches an attack on enemies ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After activating the skill, enter the Noblewoman state.
When there are Flight Feathers available, hold [Basic Attack button] during skill activation to enter the Fluttering Frock state.

skills.label: Dodge: Dainty Steps
skills.gameText:
When in the Noblewoman state and about to be attacked, an automatic dodge will trigger, during which the character will be Invulnerable, but a Perfect Dodge will not be triggered.
This can trigger once each time the Noblewoman state is entered.

skills.label: Special Attack: Song of Silver Wings
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Quickly attack forward, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Violet Requiem
skills.gameText:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Unleash a powerful forward attack that deals massive Ether DMG and grants 3 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Enter the Fluttering Frock state after using the skill. Hold [Dodge button] during the skill to enter the Noblewoman state.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Chorus of Celestial Wings
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a powerful attack on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive Ether DMG and gaining 2 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge button] during the skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Soaring Bird's Song
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Launch a powerful attack on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive Ether DMG and gaining 5 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill is activated, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge button] during the skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Frostwing Guard
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Launches an attack on enemies ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates, enter the Noblewoman state.
With Flight Feathers available, hold [Basic Attack button] during skill activation to enter the Fluttering Frock state.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Silver Umbrella Formation
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Featherblade Execution
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Launch an attack at enemies ahead, dealing Ether DMG and gaining 2 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding [Dodge button] during the skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Dirge of Destiny (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
When Basic Attack: Featherbloom hits a target suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 6.15%/3.2%/8%/0.75%/1.08%/0.32% per 10 points of Anomaly Proficiency of the original Anomaly's DMG.
When Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension or Basic Attack: Featherbloom hits a target suffering any Attribute Anomaly, apply Vivian's Prophecy to the target, causing the target to take Ether DMG equal to 55% of Vivian's ATK every 0.55s. This DMG can trigger the additional DMG of Attribute Anomalies. When the enemy is no longer suffering an Attribute Anomaly, Vivian's Prophecy expires.
Upon entering the battlefield, Vivian gains 2 Flight Feathers.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Prophetic Tears
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same attribute:
Whenever another squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, Vivian will consume 1 Guard Feather to launch Basic Attack: Featherbloom on the target. This can trigger once every 0.5s.
Corruption DMG dealt by all squad members and the Corruption status' Disorder DMG increases by 12%.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: "Walking Into the Orchard in Spring"
skills.gameText: When a total of 4 Guard Feathers are consumed, gain 1 Flight Feather. All Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG received by targets under Vivian's Prophecy increases by 16%.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: "Stormy Night, Stormy Night"
skills.gameText: Vivian's Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 25%. The benefits of Abloom from Anomaly Proficiency are raised to 130% of the original value, and 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES is ignored.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: "Another and the Same"
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: "The Wind Between the Reeds"
skills.gameText:
Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension and Basic Attack: Featherbloom will always CRIT on hit, and they will also increase Vivian's ATK by 12% for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When entering the battlefield, Vivian immediately gains 5 Guard Feathers.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: "Sonnet"
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: "Vivian"
skills.gameText: Vivian's Ether DMG increases by 40%. When triggering a Perfect Dodge during Basic Attack: Noblewoman - Waltz's dash, or using EX Special Attack: Violet Requiem, gain 1 additional Flight Feather. Launching Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension consumes all Guard Feathers, the downward attack's area of effect increases, and upon hit, triggers a special instance of Abloom. Each additional Guard Feather consumed will increase the proportion of additional Anomaly DMG dealt by that instance of Abloom, consuming a maximum of 5 Guard Feathers to increase the DMG up to a maximum of 5 times the original.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Glacial Judgment
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches up to five slashes forward, the first dealing Physical DMG, and the following four Ice DMG.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Final Verdict
skills.gameText:
Hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
After getting ready, Zhao starts charging up, then launches a forward slash on release, dealing massive Ice DMG.
While charging, Zhao accumulates up to 5s of charge time. When the Finishing Move of Basic Attack: Final Verdict, Chain Attack, or Assist Follow-Up hits, the stored charge time is consumed to deal additional DMG. For every 1 second of charge time, Zhao deals (12 + 1 × Basic Attack level)% of Max HP as additional DMG.
When Zhao is in any Ether Veil, if she gets switched out while charging, the charge can continue.
If Frostbite Points are maxed out when the skill activates, all Frostbite Points are consumed to trigger Ether Veil: Wellspring and a Quick Assist. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While not the currently controlled character, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dodge: Bunny Hop
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Bouncing Dash
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes forward, dealing Physical DMG and Ice DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Swift Blink
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Performs a falling slash ahead, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Launches a forward slash, dealing Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to (1 + 0.06 × Special Attack level)% of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge and EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra can trigger at most once every 30s.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra
skills.gameText:
With enough energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Launches multiple forward slashes, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to (1 + 0.06 × Special Attack level)% of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge and EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra can trigger at most once every 30s.
Upon activating this skill, gain 20 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Temporary Alliance
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches multiple slashes in front, dealing massive Ice DMG.
After using this skill, gains 5 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Bunny Barrage
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks in front, followed by a falling slash, dealing massive Ice DMG.
After using this skill, gains 20 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Entry Skill: Burst of Frost
skills.gameText:
When Zhao has maximum Frostbite Points, and is in combat, press [Switch button] to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks forward, followed by a slash, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a Quick Assist.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Patch the Gaps
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Launches a falling slash in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Frostveil Suppression
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Frostlight Reflection
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Launch multiple slashes in front, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, if Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Ideal Colleague (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
Zhao gains bonus CRIT Rate based on her initial Max HP, gaining 1.4% CRIT Rate for every 1,000 initial Max HP.
Upon entering the battlefield, Zhao gains 100 Frostbite Points. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. The maximum amount of Frostbite Points is 100.
When the currently active character's attacks hit an enemy, Zhao gains 6 Frostbite Points. This can be triggered once every 3s.
When Frostbite Points are maxed out, switching Zhao to the field while in combat will activate her Entry Skill.
When Zhao activates her Entry Skill, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members gain 5% Max HP for 40s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Wellspring ends the existing instance before applying a new Ether Veil: Wellspring.
When Zhao activates Ether Veil: Wellspring, all squad members' ATK increase by 1,000 for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Crystallization
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is an Attack, Anomaly, or Support character:
When Zhao is within any Ether Veil, the whole squad's DMG increases by 10%. If Zhao's initial Max HP exceeds 15,000, every additional 400 initial Max HP increases this DMG bonus by an additional 1%, up to a total maximum increase of 40%. This bonus reaches its maximum when Zhao's initial Max HP reaches 27,000.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Righteous Verdict
skills.gameText: When Zhao switches out of being the active character, all squad members' DMG ignores 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES for 50s.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Krampus Senior
skills.gameText: When Zhao recovers HP, her ATK increases by 20%, and other squad members' ATK increases by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Frostveil Edge
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Featherlight Footsteps
skills.gameText: When Zhao activates an Ether Veil, she gains 250 Decibels. The CRIT DMG of her Ultimate, Chain Attack, and Basic Attack: Final Verdict increase by 40%.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Fuzzy Listener
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: No Value Has Its Own Value
skills.gameText: The CRIT Rate buff from Core Passive: Ideal Colleague increases to 125% of the original value. The extra DMG gained from charging during Basic Attack: Final Verdict increases to 140% of the original value, and accumulated charge time is no longer consumed when attacking.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Cirrus Strike
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Perform up to five attacks forward, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
This skill's Anti-Interrupt Level increases during the 3rd and 4th hit.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Ink‐Veil Cloud Coalescence
skills.gameText:
Hold [Dodge button] to activate:
Deploy a Grand Tai Chi Formation, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
When the skill ends, automatically launch the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cirrus Strike.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Auric Array
skills.gameText:
While possessing an Auric Ink Point: tap [Basic Attack button] during Dodge: Nimbus Step, or hold [Dodge button] to activate:
Deploy an array, continuously dealing Auric Ink DMG.
When the skill ends, it automatically triggers Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption.
While channeling, continuously recover Adrenaline, recovering 7/s, for up to 3s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill, and enters the Vital View state.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption
skills.gameText:
Automatically activates when Basic Attack: Auric Array reaches the max duration:
Spreads her wings to launch an explosive attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dodge: Hidden Cloud Technique
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Skybreaker
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Launch a forward rush attack, dealing Auric Ink DMG.

skills.label: Dodge: Nimbus Step
skills.gameText:
When dragging the joystick, hold [Dodge button] to activate:
Enter a high‐speed Light as Air state. While in the Light as Air state in Investigation Zone Mode, automatically collect from all resource pickup points within range.
While in the Light as Air state, use the joystick to steer. Release the joystick to stop.
Character is invulnerable at the moment this skill activates.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Banishing Blow
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies ahead, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Shadow-Ignition
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Swiftly retreat, then attack forward, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
While retreating, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered, but cannot be followed up with a Dodge Counter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Ink Manifestation
skills.gameText:
With enough Adrenaline, press or hold [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Charge continuously, and release [EX Special Attack button] to launch an upward wing attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
While charging, incoming attacks are automatically blocked and will activate the upward wing attack.
If hit at the exact moment charging begins, it triggers a Perfect Block effect, negating the DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Heavy Defensive Assist, and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
When an upward wing strike hits an enemy with a red flash or yellow flash, a Perfect Block can be triggered, negating the hit and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Defensive Assist and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
The Perfect Block effect can occur at most once every 0.5s.
If charged until flashing or when triggering the Perfect Block effect, the upward wing attack can be followed by an additional Talisman Attack.
After the skill, press [Special Attack button] to launch EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break.
After EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break, and with enough Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack button] to consume another 20 Adrenaline to launch EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break.
After using EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold [Dodge button] to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Character is invulnerable during the upward wing attack, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper
skills.gameText:
With enough Adrenaline, hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Continuously charge up, channeling energy around enemies to deal DMG over time, up to a max of 2s, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Once fully charged or if interrupted, automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows.
At the moment the skill is activated, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered. After the Perfect Dodge, enter the Vital View state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows
skills.gameText:
Triggers automatically during EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper:
When the energy orb appears and contracts, it deals Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Auric Ink Rush
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Rapidly dash forward and attack, followed by an explosive wing burst, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Launch a barrage of wing attacks, then guide countless talismans to attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP.
After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold [Dodge button] to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression
skills.gameText:
With enough Technique Points, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Consumes 120 Technique Points to spread her wings, then guide countless talismans to attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
With both enough Technique Points and Decibels, this skill triggers with priority.
After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold [Dodge button] to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Cloudstream Shadow
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies ahead, dealing Auric Ink DMG.

skills.gameText:

Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Celestial Cloud Blitz
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Grandmaster of Mysticism (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
Yixuan gains extra Sheer Force based on her Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Auric Ink DMG Yixuan deals via her skills is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using her Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Yixuan accumulates Auric Ink Anomaly Buildup, it uses an independent Anomaly Buildup gauge, and when triggering an Anomaly, she restores an additional 10 Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 10s.
Upon entering combat, Yixuan immediately restores all Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. Triggering a Perfect Dodge grants an additional 5 Adrenaline and can occur at most once per second.
When she consumes Adrenaline, Yixuan accumulates Technique Points, gaining 0.667 points for each point of Adrenaline consumed. With enough Technique Points, she can trigger an additional Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression. The maximum for Technique Points is 120.
The DMG dealt by Yixuan's Basic Attack: Auric Array, Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption, EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, and Ultimate increases by 60%.
After launching Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, Yixuan gains one Auric Ink Point. She can spend an Auric Ink Point to launch Basic Attack: Auric Array.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Auric Ink Undercurrent
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Stun, Support, or Defense character:
When a fellow squad member uses an Ultimate, Yixuan continuously recovers 2 Adrenaline for 10s. If Yixuan is switched out by a Perfect Assist, she automatically follows up with a lightning strike attack, dealing DMG equal to 225% of her Sheer Force and restoring an additional 5 Adrenaline.
EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper and EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows deal 30% increased DMG to Stunned enemies.
After activating her Ultimate, Yixuan enters the Meditation state, increasing her CRIT DMG by 40% for 15s.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Spiritual Path
skills.gameText: Upon entering combat, CRIT Rate increases by 10% and immediately gain 120 Technique Points. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. When any squad member lands a hit on an enemy, Yixuan automatically summons an extra lightning strike, dealing DMG equal to 50% of her Sheer Force and restoring 5 additional Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 6s.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Ward Off Misfortune
skills.gameText: When an Ultimate or EX Special Attack deals DMG, it ignores 15% of the target's Ether RES. Triggering Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade extends all enemies' Stunned state by 3s. In a single Stun state duration, enemies can only have this effect applied once, and it does not stack with similar effects. Additionally, when using Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, gain one stack of the Condensed Ink effect. After Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption or EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows, press the Basic Attack button, or after EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break, press the Special Attack button to consume one stack of Condensed Ink and launch EX Special Attack: Endless Talisman Suppression - Break, dealing DMG up to 1,200% of Sheer Force. Only one stack of Condensed Ink can be held at a time.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Cycle of Yin and Yang
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: The One Path of Mysticism
skills.gameText: Activating an  Ultimate grants one stack of Tranquility, up to a max of 2 stacks. For each stack of Tranquility, the next EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper DMG and EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows DMG increase by 30%.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Calm Sky Vigil
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Swift Yet Still
skills.gameText: After using Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade, gain a stack of the Regulated Breathing effect. While under this effect, you can ignore the Technique Point cost to launch Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression once. The Regulated Breathing effect ends after Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression is used. This effect can only be gained once every 30s. Only one stack of Regulated Breathing can be held. Additionally, while in the Meditation state, Yixuan's Sheer DMG is increased by 20%.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Flaming Claw
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Slash forward up to four times, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press [Basic Attack button] to maintain the combo and keep striking the enemy.
During the 3rd hit, hold or pause before pressing [Basic Attack button] to chain into the 4th hit.
During the 3rd hit, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Hu Wei
skills.gameText:

Upon hitting an enemy, gain 20 points of Might, triggering up to once per use of a skill. The maximum for Might is 200.

skills.label: Dodge: Tiger Seven Forms - Tigerwind
skills.gameText:

A quick dash dodge.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge
skills.gameText:

skills.gameText: When Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor! heals all squad members, the HP recovery is increased by 25%, and the healing over time effect is increased by 25%. On activating Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!, gain the Backup Provisions effect. Whenever any character in the squad loses HP, consume the Backup Provisions effect to instantly restore 50% of the HP recovered with Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!'s instant HP recovery effect. This effect does not stack.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: "Thiren"
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Meridian Theory
skills.gameText: The Meridian Flow effect provided by Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment increases by an extra 6% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK. The maximum Sheer Force provided by this effect increases to 720.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Swiftedge
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
Can be chained into Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash after the 4th hit.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Cloudstream Sword Will
skills.gameText:
Hold [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches a flurry of blade shockwaves, dealing Physical DMG. Hold to extend the attack.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and on the ground, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Performs up to three forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
If struck by an enemy attack during the 3rd hit, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
If she possesses Qingming Sword Force, the 3rd hit is replaced with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and with Qingming Sword Force, after the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches a swift rising attack, dealing Physical DMG and entering an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum
skills.gameText:
After activating Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation, and with Qingming Sword Force, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches a wide sweeping slash forward, dealing massive Physical DMG. On hit, 1 point of Qingming Sword Force is consumed.
If struck by an enemy during the skill, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level.
After using this skill and with Qingming Sword Force, press [EX Special Attack button] to consume 1 point of Qingming Sword Force and launch a hit of EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light. This skill is automatically followed up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent, and Ye Shunguang enters an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight
skills.gameText:
In the Enlightened Mind state, and while airborne, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Launches up to two downward slashes in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
Press [EX Special Attack button] or [Dodge button] to follow up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation
skills.gameText:
After the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Performs a falling attack in front, entering a grounded state, and dealing Physical DMG.
When launching this skill with 2 or more points of Qingming Sword Force, Ye Shunguang will perform a downward falling strike across a large area in front instead, dealing massive Physical DMG. On hit, 2 points of Qingming Sword Force are consumed, granting the Culmination effect. After using this skill, if Ye Shunguang possesses Qingming Sword Force, press [EX Special Attack button] to consume 1 point of Qingming Sword Force and launch a hit of EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light, which can be quickly followed up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
During this skill, if attacked by enemies, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Culmination
skills.gameText: During EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light, each time Qingming Sword Force is consumed while Culmination is active, the Qingming Sword Force cost is replaced by consuming Culmination instead. This effect does not stack, and lasts until the current Enlightened Mind ends.

skills.label: Dodge: Leave No Trace
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
During the Enlightened Mind state, and if a Perfect Dodge is triggered, press [Basic Attack button] to activate Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.

skills.label: Dodge: Wandering Cloud
skills.gameText:
While tilting the joystick, hold [Dodge button] to activate:
Enters a high-speed movement state. Steer with the joystick, and release the joystick to stop.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Swallow Strike
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Guiding Tides
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a Dodge.
If no dodge is available or a Perfect Dodge is not triggered, launches a quick sword energy attack that deals Physical DMG.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered at this time, launches a flying sword attack, dealing Physical DMG, and immediately follow up with the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Swiftedge.
Character is briefly invulnerable during the skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Gale Suppression
skills.gameText:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Launches a rushing slash and a flying sword attack at the enemy, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Enemy attacks can be dodged during this skill.
After this skill is used, gain 1 point of Qingming Sword Force.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Clean Exit
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and grounded, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Performs a swift backstep slash, dealing Physical DMG.
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a Dodge.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered at this time, press [Basic Attack button] to quickly activate Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum and enter Vital View.
After this Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum activates, it can be immediately followed up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light
skills.gameText:
In the Enlightened Mind state and with Qingming Sword Force, hold [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Performs quick consecutive slashes, dealing massive Physical DMG while rapidly consuming Qingming Sword Force until none remains.
The skill ends early if Qingming Sword Force is insufficient or if [EX Special Attack button] is released.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust
skills.gameText:
In the Enlightened Mind state, press [Ultimate button] or hold [EX Special Attack button] when all Qingming Sword Force is expended to activate:
Deals massive Physical DMG to enemies in a large area.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
After using this skill, Ether Veil: Verdict is removed and the Enlightened Mind state ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Smite the Wicked
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Chasing Storms
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Summons a sword formation and enter the Enlightened Mind state, activating an Ether Veil: Verdict while also gaining 6 Qingming Sword Force. This skill deals massive Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, if Decibels are consumed, press [Ultimate button] while in this Enlightened Mind state to launch an Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens that doesn't consume Decibels.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Enlightened Mind - Lure Thunder
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state, and when a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens
skills.gameText:
After consuming Decibels to launch Ultimate: Chasing Storms and while in the Enlightened Mind state, press [Ultimate button] or hold [EX Special Attack button] when all Qingming Sword Force is expended to activate:
Summons a massive blade, dealing massive Physical DMG to enemies.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
After using this skill, the Enlightened Mind state ends, and Ether Veil: Verdict is removed.
This skill doesn't consume Decibels.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness
skills.gameText:
With 6 Qingming Sword Force and while not in the Enlightened Mind state, hold [Basic Attack button] to activate, or press [Switch button] while in combat and switch on-field from off-field to activate:
Enters the Enlightened Mind state and activates Ether Veil: Verdict.
Deals Physical DMG to enemies in a large area in front.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a Quick Assist.
Enters the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Support Guard
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Cease Hostility
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Deals massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: When I Return
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Enlightened Mind - Tactical Support
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state, when the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Launches a forward slash, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Enlightened Mind - Unification
skills.gameText:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and after a Defensive Assist, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Deals massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Burning Clarity (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
When not in the Enlightened Mind state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build Qingming Sword Force. Whenever Qingming Sword Force is gained by any means, each 1 point of Qingming Sword Force that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of Bearer, stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the Enlightened Mind state, all Bearer stacks are consumed to grant the same number of Qingming Sword Force stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain Unity, increasing CRIT Rate by 30% and DMG by 25%.
When Ultimate: Chasing Storms or Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the Enlightened Mind state and activates Ether Veil: Verdict. Ether Veil: Verdict has the same duration as Enlightened Mind. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the Enlightened Mind state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all Physical DMG dealt by her skills becomes Honed Edge DMG.
While Ether Veil: Verdict is active, when an enemy enters Ether Veil: Verdict, they gain a Veil Vulnerability effect based on their current Stun DMG Multiplier. During this, when Ye Shunguang deals DMG to enemies with her skills, enemy Stun DMG Multiplier is ignored and replaced with the Veil Vulnerability bonus. Veil Vulnerability caps at 110%. The effect is removed when Ether Veil: Verdict ends.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Shadowtrace Flight
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Defense character:
When a squadmate activates any Ether Veil, gain 3 points of Qingming Sword Force. If already in the Enlightened Mind state, this is instead converted into 3 stacks of Bearer.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Dreambound Self
skills.gameText:
Upon entering the battlefield, gains 6 Qingming Sword Force. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
The Unity effect from Core Passive: Burning Clarity increases DMG dealt by an additional 10%, and they ignore 20% of the target's DEF.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Light & Shadow
skills.gameText: The max stack count of Bearer increases to 6, and Culmination can stack up to 9 times. While in the Enlightened Mind state, each point of Qingming Sword Force consumed grants 1 stack of Culmination. EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light and Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens's DMG ignore 40% of the target's DEF.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Swordswoman
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Together into the Dust
skills.gameText: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 1,000 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. The Vulnerability bonus provided by Ether Veil: Verdict is increased to a maximum of 200%.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Guiding Glimmer
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Lantern Wish
skills.gameText: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 2 stacks of Lantern Wish. When entering the Enlightened Mind state, gains 1 stack of Lantern Wish, stacking up to 4 times. With 3 stacks of Lantern Wish, EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust is replaced with Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens. When this Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens is activated, it consumes 3 stacks of Lantern Wish. The last hit of Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust and Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens deal 1,500% of ATK as additional Physical DMG.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Blazing Wind Slash
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Perform up to three forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
During each slash, pressing [Special Attack button] triggers Scorchwind, causing the attack to deal increased Fire DMG.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash
skills.gameText:
While in the Molten Edge state, press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Unleash up to four forward slashes, dealing Fire DMG.
If Manato's HP is above 30% when the skill is activated, 3.5% of his Max HP will be consumed.

skills.label: Dodge: Radiant Blade
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Radiant Blade - Zanshin
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a shoulder slam forward, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Radiant Blade - Battle Sweep
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform a slash followed by a punch at enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Return to Ashes
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, restore 20% of missing HP when unleashing the slash. The healing effects of Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice
skills.gameText:
Hold [Special Attack button] to activate:
Enter a charging state, consuming up to 10% of Max HP and gaining 100 Blazing Heart. HP consumption will at most reduce Manato's HP to 30% of Max HP.
Release the button to activate Special Attack: Return to Ashes. If struck during the skill, the slash heals 20% of missing HP. The healing effects of Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill or if charging reaches a certain duration, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall
skills.gameText:
While in the Molten Edge state and with sufficient Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
Jump up and unleash a falling slash on enemies in front, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activating the skill, restore 33% of Max HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Blazing Eruption
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hurls his sword forward, then charges the enemy to trigger an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Musou Aratama
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
Jump into the air and deliver a falling slash at enemies in front, followed by an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Lone Shadow - Regroup
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
Slashes and punches enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Lone Shadow - Mountain Stand
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, inflicting massive Daze and dealing Fire DMG.
Gain 75 Blazing Heart upon activating this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Lone Shadow - Breaking Fang
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash multiple slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Repeated presses allow up to 7 extra consecutive slashes.
While chaining slashes, if Manato's HP is above 30%, 2% of Max HP is consumed.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Mighty Molten Edge (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
Manato gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Fire DMG Manato deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Manato uses Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice or a Defensive Assist, he accumulates Blazing Heart, up to a maximum of 100 points. At 75 Blazing Heart, Manato enters the Molten Edge state. While in the Molten Edge state, Manato consumes 3.3 Blazing Heart per second. When Blazing Heart is fully depleted, he exits Molten Edge.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's Basic Attacks are enhanced, and he can use EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall.
When consuming HP during Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash or during the consecutive slashes from an Assist Follow-Up, that attack's CRIT DMG increases by 50%, and the Adrenaline Generation Rate increases by 100%.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's CRIT Rate increases by 10%, and his Fire DMG increases by 20%.

skills.label: Additional Ability: Rekindled Heart
skills.gameText:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Stun character:
When Manato uses his Ultimate, he gains 8 stacks of Remnant Flame, and when using a Chain Attack, he gains 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, lasting 60s, stacking up to 20 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While launching Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash or during the consecutive slashes of an Assist Follow-Up, if his HP is below 100% of Max HP, one stack of Remnant Flame is consumed to restore 2% of his Max HP.

skills.label: Mindscape 1: Drifter's Rules of Survival
skills.gameText: Whenever Manato loses HP, the amount of HP lost is tallied. Each 1% of his Max HP tallied increases the Fire DMG of Assist Follow-Ups and Basic Attacks by 0.4%, up to a max of 20%.

skills.label: Mindscape 2: Day & Night, Kitchen & Love
skills.gameText: While in the Molten Edge state, Manato ignores 8% of a target's Fire RES. After being hit by an enemy while using Special Attack: Return to Ashes or Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice, press [Basic Attack button] to trigger an Assist Follow-Up.

skills.label: Mindscape 3: Enter the Realm of Urban Legends
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 4: Childhood Oath
skills.gameText: Max HP increases by 8%. During Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice, when Manato takes fatal DMG, he remains in battle, with his HP not dropping below 1. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

skills.label: Mindscape 5: Lone Shadow Returns to the Pack
skills.gameText: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

skills.label: Mindscape 6: Beyond Dreams of the Past
skills.gameText: When Special Attack: Return to Ashes hits a Stunned enemy, Manato gains 75 Blazing Heart and 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, and pressing [Basic Attack button] will launch an Assist Follow-Up. This Remnant Flame effect can trigger once every 20s. When his Assist Follow-Up hits an enemy, Manato's Fire DMG increases by 3% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.label: Basic Attack: Orbital Combo
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] to activate:
Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing Ether DMG.
The fifth attack is a Whim, conjuring an Ethereal figure that inflicts Ether DMG on enemies in a circular area ahead.
When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Whim.

skills.label: Dodge: Fading Silhouette
skills.gameText:
Press [Dodge button] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Dash Attack: Refraction
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing Ether DMG.

skills.label: Dodge Counter: Stardust Echo
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
This Dodge Counter is a Whim. When activated, summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Storm
skills.gameText:
Press [Special Attack button] to activate:
This Special Attack is a Whim. When activated, it recreates an Ethereal figure that slashes forward in a line, dealing Ether DMG.
When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

skills.label: EX Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Daybreak
skills.gameText:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack button] to activate:
This EX Special Attack is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a powerful forward slash in a line, dealing Ether DMG.
When Lucia uses any Harmony, all squad members gain the Darkbreaker state. While in Darkbreaker state, Sheer Force increases by 12. Every 200 points of Lucia's initial Max HP grants an additional (5 + 0.2 × Special Attack level) Sheer Force. The Darkbreaker state can increase Sheer Force by up to a maximum of (612 + 24 × Special Attack level), lasting 20s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24,000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value.
When any Harmony deals DMG, Lucia increases the final attack's DMG by an additional (34 + 3 × Special Attack level)% of her Max HP.
If she activates this EX Special Attack while in the Dream state and under the effect of Ether Veil: Wellspring, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 16s.
After activating her EX Special Attack, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her Basic Attack.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 60 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Chain Attack: Stage of Brilliance
skills.gameText:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
This Chain Attack is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that pulls in enemies in a circular area ahead and deals Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Ultimate: Charge, Great Armor!
skills.gameText:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate button] to activate:
This Ultimate is a Harmony. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing Ether DMG. A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a Starlight Convergence. Starlight Convergence lasts 8s. While inside Starlight Convergence, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to (1 + 0.05 × Chain Attack level)% of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the Starlight Convergence or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the Dream state and Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 100 Dream Points upon using this Harmony. If she is in the Dream state when activating this Harmony, she will gain 100 Dream Points and re-enter Dream state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

skills.label: Quick Assist: Crushing Mist
skills.gameText:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch button] to activate:
This Quick Assist is a Whim. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Defensive Assist: Voice of Illusory Dreams
skills.gameText:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch button] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Assist Follow-Up: Harmony of Painted Dreams
skills.gameText:
Press [Basic Attack button] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
This Assist Follow-Up is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.label: Core Passive: Lost Nocturne (Core Skill level 7)
skills.gameText:
When entering the battlefield, Lucia immediately gains 60 Dream Points. If her Dream Points reaches 100 upon activating a Whim or Harmony, she enters the Dream state.
When entering the Dream state, it triggers a Quick Assist and simultaneously activates Ether Veil: Wellspring. While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a max of 300s.
While Lucia is in the Dream state, using any Whim consumes 25 Dream Points and upgrades it to Harmony. Whenever another active character's attack hits an enemy, Lucia consumes 25 Dream Points to unleash an Aftershock. This Aftershock is a Harmony.
